map.和 mass-fraction 工具重合吗？: Does it overlap with the mass-fraction tool?
map.两者本质同公式；本工具面向「溶质+溶液」直接输入场景，界面更简。: They share the same formula at heart; this tool targets the direct "solute + solution" input scenario with a simpler interface.
map.质量百分数和体积百分数能互换吗？: Can mass percent and volume percent be interchanged?
map.需密度桥接，不能直接换；尤其非水体系误差大。: Density is needed as a bridge, so they cannot be swapped directly; errors are especially large for non-aqueous systems.
map.含水量算质量分数吗？: Does water content count toward mass fraction?
map.算，水作溶剂计入总质量。: Yes, water as solvent counts toward the total mass.
